title: ACK · 容器概览

list.name: view
list.label: 视图
list.query: Pod : view_pod,Node : view_node,Instance（Pod IP） : view_instance,Container : view_container

panels.title: 01 · 容器概览 — 存活与异常
panels.description: 对象状态来自 kube-state-metrics。Running 不等于 Ready；无数据不是零。

panels.title: Ready 节点
panels.description: 仅受节点筛选影响，集群整机对象。

targets.expr: sum(max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{node=~"${node}",condition="Ready",status="true"}))

panels.title: Running Pod
panels.description: 受命名空间、节点、Pod筛选影响；不受容器筛选影响。

targets.expr: sum((max by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",phase="Running"})) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"})))

panels.title: Ready Pod
panels.description: 当前可服务的 Pod 数；不是副本期望值。

targets.expr: sum((max by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",condition="true"})) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"})))

panels.title: 运行中容器
panels.description: 普通容器，不包含 init container；Running 不等于应用健康。

targets.expr: sum((max by (namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_running{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"})) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"})))

panels.title: 等待中容器
panels.description: 等待原因见异常列表；零值仅来自真实状态序列。

targets.expr: sum((max by (namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"})) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"})))

panels.title: 窗口重启次数
panels.description: 时间窗口 increase 估算，可能有小数；不等于容器存活数。

targets.expr: sum((max by (namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__range]))) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"})))

panels.title: 02 · 工作负载资源 — 随视图切换
panels.description: Pod / Container / Node / Instance（Pod IP）决定聚合口径。Node 视图这里是所选容器之和，不是整机资源。

panels.title: CPU 使用量
panels.description: cAdvisor 普通容器 CPU，排除空容器和 POD sandbox；Pod 视图包含所选容器。

targets.expr: sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((max by (namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip"))

panels.title: 内存工作集
panels.description: Working Set，不是进程 RSS；Pod 视图为所选容器工作集之和。

targets.expr: sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((max by (namespace,pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"})) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip"))

panels.title: CPU 限流周期比例
panels.description: 可选 cAdvisor 指标；按周期统计，不是被限流的 CPU 时间比例。

panels.title: 内存 RSS
panels.description: 容器 cgroup RSS；与 Working Set 含义不同。可选指标未采集时留空。

targets.expr: sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((max by (namespace,pod,container) (container_memory_rss{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"})) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip"))

panels.title: 容器运行数量趋势
panels.description: 按所选视图汇总真实 Running 状态；不使用 up 推导容器存活。

targets.expr: sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((max by (namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_running{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"})) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip"))

panels.title: 重启次数（所选时间窗口）
panels.description: increase 按整个面板时间窗口估算；可能有小数。

targets.expr: sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((max by (namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__range]))) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip"))

panels.title: 03 · 节点资源 — 整机口径
panels.description: 本区只受节点筛选影响，忽略命名空间、Pod、容器和视图。包含系统进程、所有工作负载及其他主机开销。

panels.title: 节点 CPU 使用率
panels.description: 1 - idle，各逻辑 CPU 求平均；不是 Pod CPU。node_uname_info 的 node 或 nodename 须对应 Kubernetes 节点名。

targets.expr: max by (node) ((1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

panels.title: 节点内存使用率
panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal；只受节点筛选影响。

targets.expr: max by (node) ((1 - max by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) / max by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

panels.title: 节点 Load 15m / CPU 核数
panels.description: 归一化 load，可能超过 1；不是 CPU 利用率。

targets.expr: max by (node) ((max by (instance) (node_load15) / count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"})) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

panels.title: 节点最满文件系统
panels.description: 各节点已采集文件系统的最高使用率；不是所有磁盘加总。

targets.expr: max by (node) ((max by (instance) (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs",mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/kubelet/pods/.*"} / (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs",mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/kubelet/pods/.*"} > 0))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

panels.title: 节点网络
panels.description: 主机设备总量；bond/bridge 或设备映射可能重复计算，需按实际设备拓扑调整过滤。

targets.expr: max by (node) ((sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

max by (node) ((sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

panels.title: 节点磁盘吞吐
panels.description: 主机设备总量；bond/bridge 或设备映射可能重复计算，需按实际设备拓扑调整过滤。

targets.expr: max by (node) ((sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{device!~"loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

max by (node) ((sum by (instance) (rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{device!~"loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

panels.title: 节点压力与 Ready 异常
panels.description: 1 表示压力或非 Ready；Ready unknown 也作为异常。只受节点筛选影响。

targets.expr: max by (node,condition) (kube_node_status_condition{node=~"${node}",condition=~"MemoryPressure|DiskPressure|PIDPressure",status="true"}) or max by (node,condition) (kube_node_status_condition{node=~"${node}",condition="Ready",status!="true"})

panels.title: 节点可分配 CPU
panels.description: Kubernetes allocatable 容量，不是实时空闲 CPU。

targets.expr: max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{node=~"${node}",resource="cpu",unit="core"})

panels.title: 04 · 对象清单与异常定位
panels.description: 清单保留 namespace/pod/container/node/pod_ip，方便对照 ACK 控制台。

panels.title: Pod 清单
panels.description: 包含当前选中的 Pod；无 IP 或未调度时字段可能为空。

targets.expr: max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"})

panels.title: 容器清单
panels.description: 普通容器及镜像，按 Pod 元数据关联节点和 IP。

targets.expr: (max by (namespace,pod,container,image) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"})) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))

panels.title: Pod 阶段
panels.description: Pod 状态独立于容器筛选，Container 视图下仍是 Pod 状态。

targets.expr: sum by (${view:raw},phase) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((max by (namespace,pod,phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}"})) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip"))

panels.title: 当前等待原因
panels.description: 仅列当前等待原因，如 CrashLoopBackOff、ImagePullBackOff；无异常时列表为空。

targets.expr: (max by (namespace,pod,container,reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"})) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"})) == 1

panels.title: 05 · 应用黄金指标 — Foundation
panels.description: 本区是应用埋点，不是 cAdvisor 指标。需 namespace、container 和 pod_name（或将隐藏 app_pod_label 改为 pod）。应用指标通过 namespace/pod 关联节点。

panels.title: 请求速率
panels.description: 应用进程或请求指标；按视图汇总，进程 CPU/RSS 不等于 Pod/容器整体使用量。

targets.expr: sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((label_replace(rate(server_requests_code_total{namespace=~"${namespace}",${app_pod_label:raw}=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",operation=~"${operation}"}[$__rate_interval]), "pod", "$1", "${app_pod_label:raw}", "(.+)")) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip"))

panels.description: 应用进程或请求指标；按视图汇总，进程 CPU/RSS 不等于 Pod/容器整体使用量。

targets.expr: (sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((label_replace(rate(server_requests_code_total{namespace=~"${namespace}",${app_pod_label:raw}=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",operation=~"${operation}",code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]),
